description: Phase 4: Implement all callback query handlers for the artist Instagram preview buttons — Publish, Edit Caption, Replace Image, Regenerate Video. These replace the TODO stubs created in Phase 1 step 6.

steps.task: Implement `handle_aig_pub` (Publish) callback handler in telegram.rs. On callback data `aig_pub:{id}`: (1) Parse artist_id from the callback data. (2) Load artist from DB. (3) Edit the preview message to remove buttons and show '⏳ Publishing to Instagram…' via telegram_notify::edit_message_caption_raw with reply_markup=None. (4) Call instagram::post_artist_to_instagram(state, &artist, account) where account = state.config.telegram_instagram_account(). (5) On success: edit caption to '✅ Published to Instagram!' and update artist.instagram_posted_at in DB. (6) On failure: restore the inline keyboard buttons with the error message prepended to the caption via edit_message_caption_raw.

decisions: Remove buttons during publish to prevent double-clicks
On failure, restore buttons so user can retry
learnings: InstagramPostResult has success: bool, media_id: Option<String>, error: Option<String>
knowledge.notes: The chat_id and message_id come from q.message in the CallbackQuery

steps.task: Implement `handle_aig_cap` (Edit Caption) callback handler in telegram.rs. On callback data `aig_cap:{id}`: (1) Parse artist_id. (2) Answer the callback query with text 'Send the new caption as a text message'. (3) Get the message_id from q.message. (4) Insert EditSession::AwaitingCaption { artist_id, preview_msg_id: message_id } into state.edit_sessions keyed by user_id (q.from.id). (5) Do NOT edit the preview message yet — the actual edit happens in Phase 9 when the user sends a text message.

decisions: Store edit session keyed by q.from.id (user ID) not chat_id
Answer callback query with instruction text — this shows as a toast/alert in Telegram
learnings: EditSession enum defined in Phase 1 step 7
q.from.id is the user who clicked the button

steps.task: Implement `handle_aig_img` (Replace Image) callback handler in telegram.rs. On callback data `aig_img:{id}`: (1) Parse artist_id. (2) Answer the callback query with text 'Send the new image as a photo'. (3) Insert EditSession::AwaitingImage { artist_id, preview_msg_id: message_id } into state.edit_sessions keyed by user_id. The actual image processing happens in Phase 9 when the user sends a photo.

Implement `handle_aig_vid` (Regenerate Video) callback handler in telegram.rs. On callback data `aig_vid:{id}:{track_num}`: (1) Parse artist_id and track_number (1 or 2). (2) Load artist from DB to get the video message ID (telegram_video1_message_id or telegram_video2_message_id). (3) Answer the callback query with text 'Send start timecode (e.g. 1:30 or 0 for beginning)'. (4) Insert EditSession::AwaitingTimecode { artist_id, track_number, preview_msg_id, video_msg_id } into state.edit_sessions. The actual video regeneration happens in Phase 9 when the user sends a timecode.

decisions: Track number is parsed from callback data: aig_vid:123:1 → track_number=1
video_msg_id comes from artist.telegram_video1_message_id or telegram_video2_message_id
learnings: Timecode format: M:SS (e.g. 1:30 = 90 seconds) or plain seconds (e.g. 90)
knowledge.notes: If the video message ID is None (video wasn't sent), answer with an error and don't create a session

steps.task: Wire up the callback handler stubs from Phase 1 step 6. In handle_callback_query, replace the TODO stubs with actual calls to handle_aig_pub, handle_aig_cap, handle_aig_img, handle_aig_vid. Each branch should extract the callback data, parse parameters, call the handler, and handle errors gracefully (log + answer callback query with error text).

decisions: All callbacks answer the query to dismiss Telegram's loading spinner
Errors are logged with tracing::error! and answered to the user
knowledge.notes: aig_sort: callbacks are wired in Phase 6

steps.task: Run `cargo check` from source/backend/ to verify Phase 4 compiles. Fix any compilation errors.
